q: In React 19, is forwardRef still required to pass a ref to a function component?
note: ref is an ordinary prop in 19; forwardRef is deprecated.

q: What does the React 19 use() hook do, and in what way are its calling rules different from useContext?
note: use() may be called conditionally and in loops, unlike every other hook.

q: Why does calling use() on a promise created during render in React cause the component to suspend forever?
note: Each render creates a fresh promise, so it never resolves from React's perspective.

q: Name the three values returned by React 19's useActionState hook.
note: [state, formAction, isPending]

q: React's useFormStatus() returns pending state for a form. From which component must it be called?
note: Calling it in the component that renders the form returns nothing useful.

q: Which React 19 hook shows an intended result immediately and reverts automatically if the action fails?
note: Replaces the hand-rolled set-then-roll-back pattern.

q: In React 19, what shorter syntax replaces <MyContext.Provider value={x}>?
note: <MyContext value={x}> — .Provider is deprecated.

q: Why does React 18+ run every effect twice on mount in development, and what does it mean if a component breaks under it?
note: The right fix is the cleanup, never a hasRun ref.

q: What can a React 19 ref callback return that it could not before, and what did React previously do to signal detachment?
note: It used to be called again with null.

q: Under exactly what conditions is using the array index as a React key acceptable?
note: Models say 'avoid it' without knowing when it is fine.

q: In React, what happens to a component's internal state when its key prop changes, and what pattern does this replace?
note: It replaces the reset-state-in-an-effect pattern and is cheaper and synchronous.

q: What is the difference in React between useState(createInitialValue()) and useState(createInitialValue)?
note: The first calls the function on every render and throws away the result.

q: What does React render for {items.length && <List />} when items is an empty array, and why?
note: React renders the number 0; only false, null and undefined render nothing.

q: Name two categories of errors that a React error boundary does NOT catch.
note: Boundaries only cover render, lifecycle and constructors.

q: Can a React error boundary be written as a function component with hooks?
note: getDerivedStateFromError and componentDidCatch have no hook equivalents.

q: In React, if a context value is an object literal, which consumers re-render when it changes, and what are the two remedies?
note: There is no per-field subscription; consumers re-render regardless of what they read.

q: Why must a React component never be defined inside another component's render body?
note: The subtree unmounts and remounts on every parent render.

q: Name two things a React Server Component cannot do.
note: They never hydrate, so there is no client runtime for them.

q: In React, should the 'use client' directive go on the page component or on the leaf component that needs interactivity, and why?
note: Everything imported below the boundary enters the bundle.

q: Name two APIs removed in React 19 that older React code commonly used.
note: ReactDOM.render is gone; createRoot from react-dom/client is the entry point.

q: JSX escapes interpolated text, so what are the two remaining ways a React component can introduce XSS?
note: javascript: URLs in href are the one models consistently miss.

q: Two fetches fire from a React effect as a user types, and the first resolves last. What is the resulting bug and what is the standard fix?
note: Cleanup runs before the next effect, which is what makes the guard work.
